name: Quick Study
description:
You have a natural aptitude for understanding how things work, and indulging your curiosity often pays off.

You have an extra pool of 2 MP that can be used for abilities from any Mestiere. This pool is replenished every sunrise, regardless of all other effects.

Whenever you roll Craft to attempt a task you've never attempted before, +1d. On a pass, gain 3 XP.

Describe your knack.
